title: Flavonoid-modulated JAK-STAT signaling mitigates malignant transformation and drug resistance in breast tumors: A clinically relevant 3PM-guided innovation.
authors: Kubatka, Peter; Huniadi, Mykhailo; Kapinova, Andrea; Nosalova, Natalia; Varghese, Elizabeth; Blahutova, Dana; Hornak, Slavomir; Trbolova, Alexandra; Biringer, Kamil; Adamicova, Katarina; Cizkova, Dasa; Busselberg, Dietrich; Golubnitschaja, Olga
one_liner_zh: 该文综述黄酮类化合物通过JAK-STAT信号通路调节乳腺癌恶性转化和耐药性，属于临床医学与信号通路综述，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无结合建模、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Breast cancer (BC) treatment efficacy is often compromised by tumor cell plasticity and multidrug resistance of multi-factorial origin. Among emerging therapeutic agents, flavonoids - a structurally diverse group of naturally occurring polyphenols - have demonstrated a significant potential to modulate the Janus kinase/signal transducer and activator of transcription (JAK-STAT) signaling pathway, a key driver of oncogenic transformation, immune evasion, and therapeutic failure in BC. Notably, natural compounds, including but not restricted to apigenin, quercetin, naringenin, morin, luteolin, butein, xanthohumol, silibinin, baicalein, nobiletin, rosmanol, orientin, eriocitrin, breviscapine, 8-hydroxydaidzein, icariside I, cardamonin, epigallocatechin-3-gallate, fisetin, brutieridin, melitidin, isoliquiritigenin, and sophoraflavanone G, have been recognized as potent JAK-STAT modulators in BC models. KEY SCIENTIFIC CONCEPTS OF THE STUDY: Through targeted interference with this pathway, flavonoids exert pleiotropic antitumor effects - enhancing the efficacy of chemotherapeutic agents, suppressing cellular proliferation and invasion, and reducing tumor aggressiveness. Beyond JAK-STAT signaling, flavonoids also influence several additional therapy resistance-related mechanisms, including regulation of ATP-binding cassette (ABC) transporters, promotion of apoptosis, suppression of epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) and cancer stem cells (CSCs), cell cycle arrest, mitochondrial autophagy and mitophagy modulation, as well as remodeling of the tumor microenvironment. AIMS OF THE STUDY: This article provides a comprehensive overview of the molecular mechanisms by which flavonoids overcome therapeutic resistance in BC, focusing on JAK-STAT signaling modulation. The paper follows principles of Predictive, Preventive, and Personalized Medicine (3PM), promoting the paradigm shift from reactive to proactive medicine. Contextually, it underscores the importance of multidisciplinary research to elucidate flavonoid-specific mechanisms, identify predictive biomarker panels, and develop advanced delivery systems, integrates patient phenotyping, multi-level diagnostics, and AI-driven data interpretation to enable cost-effective primary and secondary prevention, and therapeutic algorithms tailored to personalised patient profiles improving therefore individual outcomes.
abstract_zh:
背景：乳腺癌（BC）的治疗效果常因肿瘤细胞可塑性和多因素来源的多药耐药性而受损。在新兴治疗药物中，黄酮类化合物——一类结构多样的天然多酚——已显示出显著潜力，可调节Janus激酶/信号转导与转录激活因子（JAK-STAT）信号通路，该通路是乳腺癌中致癌转化、免疫逃逸和治疗失败的关键驱动因素。值得注意的是，天然化合物，包括但不限于芹菜素（apigenin）、槲皮素（quercetin）、柚皮素（naringenin）、桑色素（morin）、木犀草素（luteolin）、紫铆因（butein）、黄腐酚（xanthohumol）、水飞蓟宾（silibinin）、黄芩素（baicalein）、川陈皮素（nobiletin）、迷迭香酚（rosmanol）、荭草苷（orientin）、圣草枸橼苷（eriocitrin）、灯盏花乙素（breviscapine）、8-羟基大豆苷元（8-hydroxydaidzein）、淫羊藿苷I（icariside I）、豆蔻明（cardamonin）、表没食子儿茶素-3-没食子酸酯（epigallocatechin-3-gallate）、漆黄素（fisetin）、布鲁替丁（brutieridin）、美利替丁（melitidin）、异甘草素（isoliquiritigenin）和槐黄烷酮G（sophoraflavanone G），已被认定为乳腺癌模型中的强效JAK-STAT调节剂。

研究的关键科学概念：通过靶向干扰该通路，黄酮类化合物发挥多效性抗肿瘤作用——增强化疗药物的疗效、抑制细胞增殖和侵袭、降低肿瘤侵袭性。除JAK-STAT信号外，黄酮类化合物还影响多种与治疗耐药相关的其他机制，包括调节ATP结合盒（ABC）转运蛋白、促进细胞凋亡、抑制上皮-间质转化（EMT）和癌症干细胞（CSCs）、细胞周期阻滞、线粒体自噬和线粒体自噬调节，以及肿瘤微环境重塑。

研究目的：本文全面概述了黄酮类化合物克服乳腺癌治疗耐药的分子机制，重点关注JAK-STAT信号调节。本文遵循预测性、预防性和个体化医学（3PM）原则，推动从反应性医学向主动性医学的范式转变。在此背景下，文章强调了多学科研究的重要性，以阐明黄酮类化合物特异性机制、识别预测性生物标志物组合、开发先进递送系统，整合患者表型分型、多层次诊断和人工智能驱动的数据解读，从而实现成本效益高的初级和二级预防，以及针对个体化患者特征量身定制的治疗算法，从而改善个体预后。
